title: How to Build a High-Performing Sales Engine
summary: This video breaks down the three main components of making a sale: offer, distribution, and sales process. The creator explains how to structure your offer, handle objections, and optimize your sales funnel to maximize revenue.
key_points: To generate a million dollars, you need 20 people to pay you $4,000 for 12 months.
A sale has three main components: Offer (what you sell), Distribution (who you sell to), and Sales (how you sell to them).
A great salesperson with a mediocre distribution and offer can do well because they can drive sales.
Offer stack consists of seven components: Getting specific, Identifying obstacles, Value stack, Proof, Reduce time and effort, Reduce risk, Urgency and scarcity, Name and price.
Distribution is divided into two components: Organic distribution and Paid distribution.
The 5-minute rule: New inquiries should be answered within 5 minutes to maximize the probability of a sale.
The three gates of hell in deep discovery: Need, Decision making and timeline, Anchor.
